tagline_en: Locks in moisture, forms a protective film, keeps skin supple
tagline_zh: 增强肌肤锁水能力 · 形成保护膜 · 水润弹滑
overview_en: Contains Witch Hazel (Hamamelis virginiana) water, Sodium Hyaluronate and Ceramide to boost the skin's moisture-holding capacity, form a protective film, repair skin lipids, calm inflammation and support the skin's natural immunity.
overview_zh: 含北美金缕梅水、透明质酸钠和神经酰胺保湿成分，内源补水锁水，修护肌肤脂质，形成保护膜，减少敏感与细纹。
benefits_en: Forms a protective film and calms inflammation
Stimulates cell rejuvenation for balanced moisture
Leaves skin softer, smoother and more elastic with fewer fine lines
benefits_zh: 激活细胞焕新，平衡水分
肌肤更柔滑弹润，减少细纹
